how.title: How it works
how.step1Text: Choose where from, where to, and your travel date - then click "Find a bus".
how.step2Text: Click "Trip details" under the trip you want - see amenities, discounts, transfers and carrier info.
how.step3Text: Click the button on the trip you want and enter passenger details.
how.step4Text: We'll get in touch, confirm the booking and answer any questions.

seo.heading: Bus tickets Ukraine - Europe
seo.p1: Book bus tickets Ukraine - Europe in a minute, with no prepayment: pay the driver at boarding, no registration required. We help you quickly find and book trips to Poland, Germany, Czechia, Italy, Spain and other countries - hundreds of routes from vetted carriers, with schedule, prices, travel time and transfers all visible at once.
seo.p2: Booking takes a minute and needs no registration. Most trips can be booked with no prepayment - pay the driver at boarding. If you have questions, a real manager is always available - by phone, Telegram, Viber or WhatsApp, daily from 7:00 to 23:00.
